subject: general
question: Which of the following statements is correct about Petrology ?

options.text: It has been derived from a Latin word which means brick.
It is the branch of science concerned with the origin, structure and composition of petroleum.
It is the branch of science concerned with the origin, structure and composition of rocks.
It is the sedimentary rock formed out of deposits of glaciers.

solution:
The correct answer is __**It is the branch of science concerned with the origin, structure and composition of rocks.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Petrology** is the branch of science concerned with the** origin, structure and composition** of rocks.
 
• Petrology is derived from the **Greek word "petra"** which means **rock and "logos"** which means study or discourse.
 
• It is a sub-discipline of geology that focuses on the study of rocks, including their **formation, mineralogy, and texture**.
 
• Petrologists use various techniques such as **microscopy, X-ray diffraction, and chemical analysis** to study rocks and understand their properties.
 
• The study of petrology is important in understanding the geologic history of the Earth, as rocks provide clues about **past geological events** and processes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The branch of science concerned with the origin, structure and composition of petroleum is called** Petroleum Geology**.
 
• The sedimentary rock formed out of deposits of glaciers is called **Glacial Till or Glacial Sediment.**
 
• Any naturally occurring solid mass or combination of minerals or mineraloid materials is referred to as **rock in geology.** 
 
 
• **Igneous** rocks, **sedimentary** rocks, and **metamorphic** rocks are the three main categories into which rocks are typically divided.
 
• **Lava cooling** on the surface or beneath the ocean creates igneous rocks.
 
• Magma cooling in the **Earth's crust** also produces igneous rocks.
 
• The** weathering, movement, and deposition** of pre-existing rocks result in the diagenesis and lithification of sediments, which in turn form sedimentary rocks.
 
• When** pre-existing rocks** are exposed to extreme** temperatures and pressures** that cause them to change without significantly melting, new rocks known as metamorphic rocks are created.
